name: Spell Clear
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/ wizard 1, witch 1; Domain earth 1; Subdomain metal 1; Elemental School earth 1, metal 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration instantaneous

This spell repairs a damaged firearm held by the target creature, restoring 1d6 hit points to the firearm and removing the broken condition, as long as that condition was gained by a firearm misfire.
